title: CodeChallenge: Negation tuning in MLP neurons (part 2)

cues.en: This is the continuation of the code challenge we started in the previous video.
cues.zh: 這支影片接續上一支影片開始的程式挑戰。

cues.en: The goal of exercise three is to get the MLP activations for all of our target tokens, so that we can
cues.zh: 練習三的目標，是取得所有目標 token 的 MLP 活化，讓我們能夠

cues.en: set up a logistic regression classifier.
cues.zh: 設定邏輯斯迴歸分類器。

cues.en: You will implement the actual classifier in the next exercise.
cues.zh: 下一個練習才會真正實作分類器。

cues.en: The goal here in exercise three is to create batches and push the tokens through the model to hook the MLP activations.
cues.zh: 練習三的目標，是建立批次，將 token 送進模型，透過 hook 取得 MLP 活化。

cues.en: So you want to create two batches of data, one for the negation words and one for the affirmation words.
cues.zh: 要建立兩批資料，一批是否定詞，另一批是肯定詞。

cues.en: You can check the sizes of the batches.
cues.zh: 可以檢查批次的大小。

cues.en: These are, however, many tokens you identified and then 101.
cues.zh: 形狀是你辨識出的 token 數量，再乘以 101。

cues.en: And the idea here is that the first 90 of these tokens are the 90 tokens before each target word.
cues.zh: 概念是，每個序列前 90 個 token，是目標詞之前的 90 個 token，

cues.en: And then we have the target token.
cues.zh: 接著是目標 token，

cues.en: And then there are ten more target tokens after that.
cues.zh: 後面再有 10 個目標 token。

cues.en: And the reason why I set up, set it up this way is so that in every sequence here, the 91st token of every sequence will be the target word.
cues.zh: 之所以這樣安排，是讓每個序列的第 91 個 token，都是目標詞。

cues.en: And that is going to make things easier for grabbing the activations from those target tokens later on when we start running analyses.
cues.zh: 這樣之後開始分析時，就更容易取得目標 token 的活化。

cues.en: Once you have these batches, you can run forward passes through the model for each of the two batches.
cues.zh: 建立這些批次後，就能分別讓兩批資料在模型中執行前向傳播。

cues.en: You want to check the sizes of the activations matrix.
cues.zh: 記得檢查活化矩陣的大小。

cues.en: Here you see an example.
cues.zh: 這裡有個例子，

cues.en: This one is 178 by 101 by 5120.
Of course, that corresponds to the number of sequences, the number of tokens, and the number of neurons in each MLP expansion layer.
cues.zh: 當然，這些分別對應序列數量、token 數量，以及各個 MLP 擴張層中的神經元數量。

cues.en: Now, also remember that the way that I coded the hook, which might also be the way that you coded
cues.zh: 也要記得，按照我寫 hook 的方式，或許你也用了相同

cues.en: the hook, the activations dictionary, that variable gets overwritten every time there's a forward pass.
cues.zh: 方式，activations 這個字典變數，每次執行前向傳播都會被覆寫。

cues.en: So you have two options here.
cues.zh: 所以有兩種選擇。

cues.en: You can either recreate the hook so you can define the hook in a different way so that it doesn't overwrite, and instead it just appends another set of matrices.
cues.zh: 可以重新定義 hook，讓它不再覆寫，而是附加另一組矩陣。

cues.en: Or you can copy the activations into a different variable between running the two forward passes for the two different batches.
cues.zh: 或者在兩批資料的兩次前向傳播之間，將活化複製到另一個變數。

cues.en: Now in my opinion, that was the easier solution.
cues.zh: 我認為後者比較簡單。

cues.en: So that's what I did.
cues.zh: 所以我就採用這種做法。

cues.en: Here you can see this variable is the activations for the affirmations word.
cues.zh: 這裡這個變數，是肯定詞的活化。

cues.en: And I have a different variable for the negations word.
cues.zh: 另外還有一個變數，存放否定詞的活化。

cues.en: Again that is my solution.
cues.zh: 同樣，這是我的解法。

cues.en: You can do that if you also like that approach.
cues.zh: 如果你也喜歡這個方式，可以照著做。

cues.en: But you can also do it differently if you prefer.
cues.zh: 但你想用不同方式也可以。

cues.en: Anyway, once you have these activations matrices, you will be ready to do some analyses and visualizations.
cues.zh: 總之，有了這些活化矩陣，就能開始進行分析與視覺化。

cues.en: But that will come in the next exercise.
cues.zh: 不過那是下一個練習的事情。
